title: Sensors: distance, IR remote, touch
summary: Three sensor helpers timed by the FPGA to the microsecond: HC-SR04 ultrasonic distance, any NEC infrared remote control, and a capacitive touch pad.
wiring: 3.3 V is enough to trigger it
HC-SR04 ECHO through a divider: 1 kohm from ECHO, 2 kohm to GND
ECHO is 5 V: never connect it directly
a wire or a coin as the pad, and 1 Mohm to 3.3 V
works without the resistor too (less sensitive)
IR receiver VCC / HC-SR04 VCC (5 V)
parts: HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor + 1 k and 2 k resistors
IR receiver VS1838B and any TV / NEC remote
1 Mohm resistor and a coin or foil for the touch pad
tested: the self-test passed 10 of 10 checks on the real board (October 2026), with nothing connected.
